answer: Under the ripple, identity is earned rather than claimed — no proof, no seat at the table. A stake that vests on good behaviour turns each fake into a hostage: behave and it returns, spam and it is gone. The zephyr prices misbehaviour directly — the attacker must fund every clone up front and loses the stake on every clone the graders catch. The violet turns sybil resistance into bookkeeping: if the cost per fake exceeds the reward per fake, the attack dies.
